provider: GCP research credits programme (Cloud for Higher Education)

free_tier.stated: $5,000 one-time for faculty/postdoc; $1,000 per year for PhD students. Credit-denominated, buys GCS at list price (~$20/TB-month Standard).

egress.terms: Metered at standard GCS rates unless fronted by Cloudflare; credit covers it.

tooling: GCS JSON/XML API, gsutil, rclone 'gcs' backend.
chaining: PhD students can re-apply annually - the only genuinely recurring line here. $1,000/yr is roughly 4 TB-months of Standard storage, so it funds a working set, not an archive.
limits_note: Only available in the countries on Google's dropdown; must be a faculty member, postdoc, or PhD student at a listed institution; masters students ineligible. Faculty may apply only once, ever ('you are only eligible to apply one time'). 6-8 week review. One applicant per research proposal.
reliability_note: Credits expire; GCS bills continue after the credit is exhausted. No data loss, just a bill.

evidence.proved: 'PhD students conducting research may apply for $1000 in GCP Credit per year'; 'Faculty and Postdoctoral researchers are eligible for one award of up to $5,000 USD'
'if you are a faculty member or postdoctoral researcher you are only eligible to apply one time'
'The program is currently only available in the countries listed'; form requires organisation name and faculty-directory link
